subject: Armature: close schedule proposal & procurement sequencing for MSA/DPA/order form
messages:
From: Susan Kim <susan.kim@orchardhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@orchardhealth.com
Date: 2026-05-21T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP request + procurement timing

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our technical team was impressed with the latency profiles and the quantization options. Procurement asked me to start a mutual action plan so we can lock a realistic timeline for signature and pilot start. Two specific asks from our side: 

1) We need a skeleton MAP with milestone dates for legal/procurement review (MSA + DPA) and a target order form execution date.
2) Can you confirm what evidence we can provide for our security review (SOC2, retention policy, audit logs) and the expected window to get the DPA in place?

I've attached our security questionnaire (Orchard_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf) — procurement will return it filled in, but they want to see the MAP first so the legal team can schedule redline windows.

Target for us: procurement wants contract complete within 4 weeks of MAP agreement if possible; pilot kickoff to follow within 2 weeks after order form. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Susan
Susan Kim
Procurement Manager, Orchard Health
procurement@orchardhealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Susan Kim <susan.kim@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + procurement timing

Hi Susan — great to hear, and thanks for sharing the questionnaire.

High level response and proposed MAP (attached as redwood_map_draft.xlsx):
- Week 0 (this week): Agree MAP and confirm procurement/legal owners.
- Week 1: Redlines window for MSA (10 business days) — Redwood legal to produce baseline MSA + proposed DPA language.
- Week 2: Concurrent DPA review (we typically run DPA review in parallel with commercial redlines to save time).
- Week 3: Finalize MSA + DPA; pricing/order form locked and countersigned.
- Week 4: Order form execution and purchase order issuance.
- Week 6: Pilot start (2 weeks after order form to allow provisioning and onboarding).

We can compress the MSA window if Orchard can commit to a single named reviewer and a 48-hour turnaround on Redwood responses for the first two rounds. For evidence: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), retention and deletion policy summary, log-sampling export, and a short runbook on KV cache isolation for customer tenants. We'll reference the SOC2 in the MAP and attach copies after the NDAs / DPA stage as needed.

I've attached the MAP draft with milestone placeholders and an initial list of required evidence. Please confirm: who at Orchard will be the legal reviewer and procurement approver so I can put names on the milestones.

Also flagging two dependencies that could push the schedule: 1) any DPA exceptions beyond standard data processing clauses, and 2) enterprise SSO/KMS integration requests.

If that timeline looks good, Laura can pick up the redlines cadence once you confirm reviewers.

Best,
Marcus
Director, GTM Operations — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_map_draft.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Susan Kim <susan.kim@orchardhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + procurement timing

Hi Susan — looping in legal and commercial sequencing notes.

Thanks Marcus for the draft — a couple of practical adjustments from legal's side based on recent experience: 

• Redline cadence: Legal needs a minimum 10 business days for an initial internal review (we can often turn first-pass redlines in 5 business days if both parties limit changes). Plan for two review rounds in parallel (Redwood <-> Orchard).
• DPA sequencing: We prefer to negotiate DPA language in parallel with the MSA so there are no downstream delays. If Orchard requests non-standard privacy terms, flag immediately — that will add iterations.
• Order form: Best practice is to lock commercial terms (pricing, term, SLAs) in the order form and sign MSA + DPA as the master contract. We can sign the order form conditionally if both legal teams agree on the MSA redlines with a named fallback clause.

Practical recommendation for the MAP dates (updated):
- MAP sign-off: 2026-05-24 (this email thread confirms scope; please reply with named reviewers)
- MSA first redlines shared: 2026-05-28
- MSA final and DPA agreed: 2026-06-11
- Order form signed: 2026-06-15
- Provisioning & billing milestone: invoice sent on order-form signature; pilot provisioning to start 10 business days later (target 2026-06-29)

If Orchard agrees to the parallel DPA approach and assigns a single point of contact for legal redlines, we can hit these dates. Rishi — can you confirm SOC2 deliverable cadence (we usually provide within 48 hours of a signed NDA/DPA)? Olga — I'll need your team listed as the execution contact for order form provisioning.

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
